actions.action: Verify account ownership, approve and publish the project-introduction post.
actions.objective: Reach advisory-led buyers with a fact-safe project introduction.
actions.buyer_intent: Azizi Florence project details and availability
actions.why_now: Highest-fit professional channel for Finding Stories advisory positioning.
actions.approval_requirement: Authorized account owner and content approver.
actions.evidence_required: Owned account URL, public post URL, screenshot and publication time.
actions.next_action: Operator verifies the account URL and records approval before publishing.
actions.success_definition: A public approved post generates attributable project sessions or an enquiry.
actions.success_metric: Referral sessions, WhatsApp clicks, lead_form_start and lead_success.
actions.revenue_connection: Professional discovery to buyer guide to advisor enquiry.

actions.action: Send the audience-matched message to one relevant existing contact.
actions.objective: Create a qualified one-to-one project visit.
actions.buyer_intent: Azizi Florence project details and availability
actions.why_now: Direct, contextual sharing has a short path to advisor conversation.
actions.approval_requirement: Authorized advisor selects a consented, contextually relevant recipient.
actions.evidence_required: Internal send record without exposing personal data in repository; attributed session or response when available.
actions.next_action: Choose the correct prepared message for a known relevant recipient.
actions.success_definition: Recipient visits the guide and starts a relevant conversation or enquiry.
actions.success_metric: WhatsApp clicks, referral sessions and qualified leads.
actions.revenue_connection: Trusted share to direct advisor conversation.

actions.action: Verify ownership and publish the residence-mix feed asset with an approved visual.
actions.objective: Support visual project discovery and buyer comparison.
actions.buyer_intent: Azizi Florence project details and availability
actions.why_now: Existing approved image reference and complete caption are ready.
actions.approval_requirement: Authorized account owner, copy approval and image-rights confirmation.
actions.evidence_required: Owned account URL, rights confirmation, live post URL and screenshot.
actions.next_action: Verify account and visual rights; then publish exactly the approved asset.
actions.success_definition: A verified public post sends attributable buyer visits to Florence.
actions.success_metric: Instagram referral sessions, WhatsApp clicks and lead_success.
actions.revenue_connection: Visual discovery to project consideration and enquiry.

actions.action: Identify and verify one real publication whose current audience fits one prepared angle.
actions.objective: Create a legitimate editorial path for buyer education.
actions.why_now: Five source-aware pitches are ready, but no recipient is asserted.
actions.approval_requirement: Human verifies publication, current section, contact route and approves outreach.
actions.evidence_required: Publication domain, relevant recent coverage URL, public contact route and review date.
actions.next_action: Research one publication and record evidence; do not send until approved.
actions.success_definition: A tailored pitch is approved and sent to a verified relevant editor.
actions.success_metric: Verified target, outreach sent, response, live citation and referral sessions.
actions.revenue_connection: Trusted editorial discovery to buyer guide and enquiry.

actions.action: Select one documented relationship and tailor the matching partner template.
actions.objective: Enable a useful project referral in an existing professional context.
actions.why_now: Relationship-first distribution can qualify context before the visit.
actions.approval_requirement: Relationship owner confirms context and approves the one-to-one message.
actions.evidence_required: Internal relationship basis, approved copy and send outcome; no personal data in generated files.
actions.next_action: Relationship owner selects a role template and adds truthful context.
actions.success_definition: A relevant partner shares the guide with an eligible buyer or requests more information.

actions.target_name: Legitimate UAE business or property directory opportunity
actions.action: Verify a moderated, relevant directory and its business eligibility requirements.
actions.objective: Establish accurate entity discovery without bulk listing.
actions.buyer_intent: Find and validate a UAE property advisory resource.
actions.why_now: Business copy exists, but identity and eligibility fields remain missing.
actions.approval_requirement: Human verifies target, entitlement and business identity fields.
actions.evidence_required: Exact domain, submission policy, category fit, required fields and review date.
actions.next_action: Name and verify one directory; reject unmoderated or irrelevant candidates.
actions.success_definition: One eligible profile is ready for truthful human submission.
actions.success_metric: Verified profile target, submitted profile, live citation and referral sessions.
actions.revenue_connection: Entity discovery to project guide and enquiry.
